development_only_input.use: candidate timing/classification rule only; development counts are not promotion evidence

candidate_policy.name: R3-M
rules: Once a public Magda tutor activation is on the stack, removing Magda does not erase it; Tidebinder is a direct current-activation answer only when its ETB trigger is live.
Once a public Clock of Omens activation is on the stack, removing Clock does not erase it; Tidebinder is a direct current-activation answer only when its ETB trigger is live.
A legal noncreature permanent answer may instead stop a Clock activation by removing its only target artifact before resolution; this is distinct from removing Clock itself.
If Torpor Orb is active, do not count Tidebinder alone because its ETB is suppressed.

With Torpor Orb active, Beast Within or Chaos Warp plus Tidebinder is a valid two-layer line only when the full sequence is legally affordable before the current activation resolves; spend the permanent answer once.
Countering the activation does not refund five Treasures or Clock's tapped-artifact costs.

invariants: paid Magda activation costs are never refunded
paid Clock activation costs are never refunded
source removal never erases an already-stacked Magda or Clock activation
Torpor Orb suppresses Tidebinder's enters trigger while Orb remains
one Beast Within or Chaos Warp card cannot be spent on both Orb and Clock target
direct removal of Clock's target is distinct from source removal
no hidden opponent hand information is used
no cell is labeled a game win or matchup result

promotion_scope.if_pass: promote R3-M as Race public-state timing overlay only
promotion_scope.if_fail: reject R3-M and return to development under a new protocol
